purpose: Required assumptions to convert a future PyPSA system run into billable domestic demand. Populate and version this file for every forecast case.

system_demand_mwh.source: PyPSA accounting.demand_MWh or full-year network demand
system_demand_mwh.note: Includes every demand sector represented by the model; it is not automatically supplier sales.

supplier_sales_conversion.note: Converts system demand to metered supplier sales after the defined treatment of losses, behind-the-meter generation, storage and exports.

domestic_recovery_share.source: Applicable Ofgem/NESO charging or levy methodology
domestic_recovery_share.note: Use only for components whose recovery is not already provided as a domestic allowance.

domestic_customer_accounts.note: Required for customer- or meter-recovered components and standing-charge allocation.

representative_customer_consumption_kwh.note: Used only to express the final representative bill; do not use it as the recovery denominator for all components.

regional_and_payment_allocation.source: Applicable price-cap levelisation and tariff methodology
regional_and_payment_allocation.note: Required before reporting regional standing and unit rates.
